clue.text: Roman poet with skills in judo and karate

parts.note: Martial was a Latin poet famous for his epigrams
arts are skills or crafts

explanation.surface: A classical poet who also happens to be handy at judo and karate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman poet' suggests Ovid or Virgil, but the poet needed is Martial, the epigrammatist, whose name doubles as an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Judo and karate are examples of combat disciplines from East Asia.

clue.text: It sounds as though my fireplace has to move elsewhere

indicators.note: the clue openly says the words that follow are to be said aloud

parts.note: a grate is the metal frame of a fireplace, so 'my fireplace' is spoken as 'my grate'

explanation.surface: Someone's hearth apparently needs relocating.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken quickly, 'my grate' matches the answer exactly; 'has to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To shift from one region or country to another is the core sense of the verb.

clue.text: The domain of a genuine Frenchman

parts.note: genuine means real
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, the French title for a man

explanation.surface: Asking whose territory a true Frenchman rules.
explanation.walkthrough: M is the standard abbreviation of Monsieur, so a Frenchman gives M.
explanation.definitionFit: A kingdom or sphere of influence is a domain.

clue.text: Brewed a beer in it when drunk

indicators.note: brewing works ingredients up into something new, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tipsy describing how a beer got into something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brewed' rearranges A BEER IN IT; 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective the word means intoxicated, a formal synonym.

clue.text: Implement brought up to make rifle

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing a word up reads it from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: a tool is an implement

explanation.surface: A tool being converted into a gun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rifle' looks like the gun, but here it is the verb meaning to ransack.
explanation.definitionFit: To rifle a place is to plunder or steal from it.

clue.text: It leads the orator to richer variety

indicators.note: variety implies a different arrangement, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Something guiding a speaker towards a richer range of expression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' signals an anagram of TO RICHER; the definition is the whole opening phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The art of persuasive speech is what guides a public speaker.

clue.text: Room where Sarah's performing

parts.note: Sal is a familiar short form of Sarah; the 's is read as 'is'
a performer who is on stage is 'on'

explanation.surface: Pointing out the room where Sarah is putting on a show.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Sarah's performing' as 'Sal is on'.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawing room or reception room in a grand house is called this.

clue.text: Mr Attlee showing the quality of mercy

definitions.meaning: ... Attlee was the British Labour prime minister from 1945 to 1951

explanation.surface: A post-war British prime minister revealed as merciful.
explanation.definitionFit: Attlee's first name, and an adjective meaning lenient or mild.

clue.text: In surroundings of stress I had a crash

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other, which surrounds it

parts.note: an accent is stress on a syllable
I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: Someone explaining that they crashed while under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' is the emphasis on a syllable, not anxiety.
explanation.definitionFit: A collision or smash is a road mishap.

clue.text: Darling, pay attention to musical embellishment

parts.note: Grace Darling was a Victorian lighthouse keeper's daughter famed for a sea rescue
to note something is to pay attention to it

explanation.surface: A sweetheart being told to notice a flourish in the music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Darling' reads as an endearment but is the surname of Grace Darling, an English heroine who rowed out to rescue shipwreck survivors in 1838.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornamental extra note added to a melody, such as an appoggiatura.

clue.text: Draw about a hundred in cash

indicators.note: one word goes round the other

parts.note: to draw someone in is to lure them
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Withdrawing about a hundred pounds in cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' suggests drawing money, but it means attract.
explanation.definitionFit: A disparaging word for money, as in 'filthy' money.

clue.text: I dream madly of gaining esteem

indicators.note: madly suggests wild disorder, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dreamer whose fantasies involve winning respect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madly' rearranges I DREAM; 'of gaining' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To respect or think highly of someone.

clue.text: A piece for brass and wind instruments

parts.note: a horn is a brass instrument
a pipe is a simple wind instrument; the plural covers both horn and pipe

explanation.surface: A composition scored for brass and woodwind.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'A piece', here a lively dance tune associated with sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: A brisk solo dance tune traditionally linked with sailors is a musical piece.

clue.text: Aim by listener to win affection

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
the ear is the organ of hearing, a listener

explanation.surface: Someone trying to win love by being a good listener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To make oneself loved or liked by others.

clue.text: Transportation of French servants' uniform

parts.note: de is French for of
livery is the distinctive dress worn by servants

explanation.surface: Shipping uniforms for French household staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Conveying goods to a recipient is transport.

clue.text: I meet people covered in surgical dressing and embrocation

indicators.note: one piece is wrapped inside another

parts.note: lint is a soft fabric used for dressing wounds
men are people

explanation.surface: Someone meeting folk swathed in bandages and liniment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meet' is a link; 'and' joins to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A rub or lotion applied to ease aching muscles.

clue.text: Conniving old South American laughs uproariously

parts.note: the Inca were the ancient people of Peru
to hoot is to laugh loudly

explanation.surface: A scheming ancient Peruvian breaking into loud laughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in secret partnership or collusion with someone.

clue.text: Reformed addict in charge of instruction

indicators.note: reformed means formed again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A former addict now running a teaching course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reformed' suggests a cured addict but rearranges ADDICT.
explanation.definitionFit: Intended to teach, educational.

clue.text: Official notification that the gun is loaded

definitions.meaning: a short public statement of news
read as '...', the state of a loaded gun

explanation.surface: An announcement warning that a weapon is loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal news announcement, and split in two it says a round is in the chamber.

clue.text: Bombardment results in local fury

parts.note: in Britain one's local is the nearby pub, so a bar
rage is fury

explanation.surface: A row in the neighbourhood turning into a bombardment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' is the British word for one's neighbourhood pub; 'results in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy, continuous artillery fire on an area.

clue.text: Block the manufacture of hard liquor

definitions.meaning: to stop or block a plan

explanation.surface: Shutting down a distillery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the manufacture of' links the two senses in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb meaning to thwart, and the name of the whisky from Scotland.

clue.text: Clearly standing with one's back to the fire is a precarious situation

definitions.text: Clearly standing with one's back to the fire
definitions.meaning: warming the backside at a fire literally heats the bottom you sit on

explanation.surface: Warming oneself by the fire as a risky place to be.
explanation.definitionFit: A position of difficult responsibility, and literally a warmed backside.

clue.text: Going back proves a change for the worse

definitions.meaning: a setback or downturn in fortune

explanation.surface: Retreat seen as a decline.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnaround, and a setback in fortunes.

clue.text: Circular telephones

explanation.surface: Phones that are round.
explanation.definitionFit: Round bands, and the verb meaning calls by phone.

clue.text: Henry takes beer into Connecticut holiday home

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: CT is the postal abbreviation for Connecticut
H is the symbol for henry, the unit of inductance
ale is beer

explanation.surface: A man named Henry bringing beer to his New England vacation cottage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden Alpine-style cottage used for holidays.

clue.text: Stretched out telling tales

explanation.surface: Someone lounging while fibbing.
explanation.definitionFit: Reclining flat, and also being untruthful.

clue.text: Idi admits to being at home

parts.note: 'I am' is admitting to being
in means at home

explanation.surface: A dictator confessing he is in.
explanation.walkthrough: Idi Amin was the dictator of Uganda in the 1970s; the definition is his first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Idi was the first name of the Ugandan dictator, so the surname completes it.

clue.text: In favour of getting in an item of protective wear

parts.note: pro means in favour of

explanation.surface: Supporting the wearing of protective clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A garment tied over the front to keep clothes clean.

clue.text: Time to get up and yield to circumstances

parts.note: tempo is musical time
to rise is to get up

explanation.surface: An instruction to get out of bed and go with the flow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To stall or comply for the moment to gain time.

clue.text: Another view of clairvoyance

definitions.meaning: the supposed power to see the future

explanation.surface: Psychic power as a second opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: A further look, and the supposed gift of foresight.
